items.title: 江苏提出到2030年基本实现交通运输现代化
items.summary: 中新网南京11月20日电 (记者 徐珊珊)11月19日，江苏省政府召开新闻发布会，解读近日印发的《江苏省“十五五”综合交通运输体系发展规划》(简称《规划》)。《规划》明确，到2030年，江苏基本实现交通运输现代化，总体发展水平居全国前列；到2035年，总体达到世界发达国家水平。
items.titleEn: Jiangsu proposes to modernize transport by 2030
items.summaryEn: On November 19, the government of Jiangsu Province held a press conference to explain the development plan of the integrated transportation system of Zhejiang Province (Zhejiang Provinces), which was recently published. The plan clearly states that by 2030, Jiangsu will achieve transportation modernization in a fundamental way, with the overall level of development leading the country; by 2035, it will reach the level of the world's developed countries overall.

items.title: 明起新一轮冷空气接踵而至 我国大部将迎大风降温
items.summary: 今天（12月14日），全国大部降水仍稀少，雨雪零散分布，冷空气影响也进入尾声阶段。不过，从明天开始，新一轮实力更强的冷空气接踵而至，将率先从新疆北部展开，随后逐渐给我国大部地区带来大风降温天气，同时西南、江汉等地降水也将增多。
items.titleEn: A new round of cold air is expected to bring much of our country to the brink of cooling.
items.summaryEn: Today (December 14), most of the country's rainfall is still scarce, rain and snow are scattered, and the effects of cold air are in the final stages. However, starting tomorrow, a new wave of stronger cold air will be delivered from northern Xinjiang, which will gradually bring cooler weather to much of China, while rainfall will increase in southwest, Jianghan and other areas.
